input.content: Flipping a feature/mode default flag (e.g. DETAILED_REPORT False->True) promotes a latent defect from an opt-in path onto the default path. Example: summarize(values, detailed=True) computed sum/len without an empty guard; it was only reachable via explicit detailed=True, but enabling detailed by default made report([]) raise ZeroDivisionError, violating the documented 'empty batches valid in either mode' contract. Review pattern: when a default flips, re-test the newly-defaulted branch across all boundary inputs (empty, zero, None), not just the one updated happy-path test.
